routes.name: Temporary Residence Visa, Rentista
routes.summary: Two-year residence for people with steady income from abroad, like rent or investments. Needs at least 3 monthly minimum wages (SBU) and health insurance.

other: Lawful monthly income of at least 3 SBU, such as lease contracts or investment securities, apostilled or legalized
Add US$250 of monthly income for each dependent
If already in Ecuador, you need a valid tourist permit or visa
The page does not give the SBU in dollars, check the current value with the ministry

steps: Start a new visa application and pick the visa type
Fill in the form and upload documents
Pay the same day online or at Banco del Pacifico, or the application is deleted at 23:55
documents: Color JPG photo, 5x5 cm, white background, max 1 MB
Criminal record certificate (adults), translated and apostilled or legalized, valid 180 days
Proof of lawful means of living (Acuerdo Ministerial 70, June 2024)
Health insurance valid for the whole visa period, covering Ecuador
routes.processing: Not stated on the official page.

routes.name: Temporary Residence Visa, Rentista for Remote Work (Digital Nomad Visa)
routes.summary: Up to two years for people who work remotely for an employer or clients abroad and earn at least 3 monthly minimum wages (SBU) from foreign sources.

other: Foreign income of at least 3 SBU per month for the 3 months before applying, or 36 SBU per year, shown with international bank statements
Proof you work remotely for an employer or clients abroad, or own a company registered abroad
Add US$250 of monthly income for each dependent
Nationality must be on the Ministry of Tourism list. The page says all countries but tells you to verify
The page does not give the SBU in dollars, check the current value with the ministry

stay.note: Page cites the law: temporary residence is renewable once.

steps: Start a new visa application and pick the visa type
Fill in the form and upload documents
Pay the same day online or at Banco del Pacifico, or the application is deleted at 23:55
documents: Color JPG photo, 5x5 cm, white background, max 1 MB
Criminal record certificate (adults), translated and apostilled or legalized, valid 180 days
Proof of lawful means of living (Acuerdo Ministerial 70, June 2024)
Health insurance valid for the whole visa period, covering Ecuador
Proof of remote work or services for a foreign employer or client
